title: Gemini CLI gets stuck at interactive prompt creating vite app

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a clear report that Gemini CLI hangs at interactive prompts when creating a Vite app, and requests adding a behavioral eval and updating system prompts to ensure non-interactive flags are used.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The change involves adding explicit non-interactive scaffolding guidance to the interactive command prompt snippets in packages/core/src/prompts/snippets.ts and adding a new test case to evals/interactive-hang.eval.ts, which is a localized prompt and test update.

summary.problem: Gemini CLI gets stuck at interactive prompts when prompted to create or scaffold a new Vite application.
summary.root_cause: The system prompt snippet for interactive shell command usage in packages/core/src/prompts/snippets.ts lacks explicit instructions for the model to use non-interactive flags (e.g. '--yes', '-y', '--template') when calling project scaffolding commands like 'npm create vite'.
summary.context: Executing project creation commands without non-interactive flags causes CLI tools to block waiting for user input on stdin, leading to hangs.

steps: Update toolUsageInteractive in packages/core/src/prompts/snippets.ts to specify that scaffolding commands (such as 'npm create vite' or 'npm init') must be passed non-interactive flags (e.g. '--yes', '-y', or specific template parameters) to prevent blocking on interactive prompts.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: The agent uses non-interactive flags when creating a Vite application, allowing the command to complete without hanging.
verification_steps: Add a new behavioral eval in evals/interactive-hang.eval.ts for creating a Vite app.
Assert that the shell command executed by the agent includes non-interactive flags such as '--yes', '-y', or '--template'.
Execute 'npx vitest run evals/interactive-hang.eval.ts' to verify that the test suite passes.
